_doc: Impls retired because their mechanism cannot be MEASURED as what it claims to be, not because they scored badly. Two families so far. (1) Most of these key on a command step whose paired observation is absent: identically false in training (collate clears key_pad for a command and its observation together) and true at scoring only at the final read, whose observation is the withheld answer — so they train without gradient and cannot act before the read. Every move step does carry an observation; it is exit 0 with empty output, identical across all 23,874 of them, so it binds a constant and the identity of what moved lives only in the command text. (2) stream/alias_resolved_content_codes instead solves the objective OUTSIDE the model, resolving the move chain in Python and stamping the answer into the scored read token. Retirement stops an impl entering new candidates and stops its name appearing in a brief; the archive keeps every record and score it earned, and the source stays on disk so archived genomes remain resolvable. Retiring an impl and retracting the candidates selecting it are separate acts — doing only the first leaves the mechanism reachable as a parent.
